preconditions.description: The input x must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(len(word) == len(inside_out(word)) for word in x.split())
postconditions.description: The length of each word in the output must be the same as the length of the corresponding word in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(inside_out(word) == word[0] + word[-1] + word[2:-2][::-1] + word[1] if len(word) > 2 else word[::-1] for word in x.split())
postconditions.description: Each word in the output must be the result of moving the internal letters of the corresponding word in the input towards the center, leaving the middle letter unchanged if the word length is odd.
